name: A100 SXM4 80GB
notes: FP8/FP6/FP4 Tensor Core fields are null because Ampere does not support these precisions at all -- not merely unpublished. No plain (non-Tensor-Core) FP16 vector figure is published by NVIDIA for A100. tdp_watts_max of 400W is the standard SXM4 configuration; datasheet footnote notes a custom-thermal-solution (CTS) HGX A100-80GB SKU can support up to 500W, not recorded as a separate field since it's a non-standard/custom config rather than a distinct catalog SKU. MIG: up to 7 instances @ 10GB each.

_sources.release_date: http://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-doubles-down-announces-a100-80gb-gpu-supercharging-worlds-most-powerful-gpu-for-ai-supercomputing (SC20, Nov 16 2020 -- separate later announcement for the 80GB variant, distinct from the original 40GB launch)
_sources.tdp_watts_max: https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/Data-Center/a100/pdf/nvidia-a100-datasheet-us-nvidia-1758950-r4-web.pdf (footnote: 400W standard; custom-thermal-solution HGX A100-80GB CTS SKU supports up to 500W)
